utterances.speaker: Guillaume
utterances.text: Good morning everyone. Let's start the weekly sync. The main topic today is the release of version 2 of the mobile app, planned for the end of the month.

utterances.speaker: Flo
utterances.text: Thanks Daniel. On the backend side, the new payment API is done, but we still have a performance problem with the leaderboard query. It takes about 3 seconds under load.

utterances.speaker: Guillaume
utterances.text: 3 seconds is too slow. Can you investigate and propose a fix by Friday?

utterances.speaker: Flo
utterances.text: Yes, I'll look at adding an index and caching the results. I'll send a proposal by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: From the design side, the new onboarding screens are ready. I still need feedback from marketing on the welcome text.

utterances.speaker: Guillaume
utterances.text: Okay, let's decide now. We will ship the new onboarding in version 2, and the dark mode moves to version 2.1.

utterances.speaker: Speaker 2
utterances.text: Agreed. I will contact Sarah from marketing today to get the final text.

utterances.speaker: Flo
utterances.text: One open question. Do we need to support Android 11, or can we drop it? I don't know how many users are still on it.

utterances.speaker: Guillaume
utterances.text: Good question. I will check the analytics and answer next week. Anything else? No? Then thanks everyone. See you next Tuesday.
